title: Runner protocol v1 request envelope
$comment: HARNESS.md 7.1-7.3. Runner JSON rejects unknown members, duplicate member names, and every bare JSON number; those lexical rules are enforced by the strict codec, this schema covers structure. Milestone 1 admits hello, deriveIdentity, authorRecord, and verifyRecord; per-operation input shapes are normative in operations.schema.json ($defs/<operation>Input). Later milestones extend the operation enum without changing the envelope.
